payout_quote: Textbook Buyback — Compare textbooks buyback prices and pick the best offer. Shipping costs included.
timing: BookFinder pays nothing itself; timing depends on the buyback vendor you select from the comparison.
eligibility: Anyone with textbooks to sell; no account or student status required to compare prices.
catches: BookFinder never buys your book — it only compares other vendors' buyback offers; you complete the sale with a third party.
Buyback value varies per book, edition, condition, and vendor — the $200 headline is unsupported and unrealistic for most books.
Older editions and low-demand titles may get no offers at all.

weasel_words.quote: No fixed dollar amount on the official site — '$200' is an unsupported headline; actual quotes vary per book and vendor.

steps: Go to https://www.bookfinder.com/ and use the 'Textbook Buyback' option in the For Students section.
Search by ISBN to get the exact edition of your textbook.
Compare the buyback offers from the listed vendors, including shipping costs.
Pick the best offer and click through to that vendor's site.
Follow the vendor's own sell process (enter condition, accept quote, ship with their label).
Track the vendor's payment timing — BookFinder has no role after you leave its site.
biggest_catch: BookFinder doesn't buy books — it only compares vendors' offers, so the $200 headline is meaningless; your payout is whatever a vendor quotes for your specific book.
notes: Verified as a live official price-comparison tool. Route's $200 claim unsupported. Frame as 'compare buyback offers', never as a fixed payout.
